thread:
mina: FYI I opened a PR to refresh the hello-rust quickstart: updated SDK v5 snippets, added a minimal Dockerfile for local deploy, and clarified env/auth steps. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/859
raj: nice. which files did you touch?
mina: docs/quickstart/hello-rust.md and docs/quickstart/docker-deploy.md
elaine: can you paste the Dockerfile you added? quick sanity check.
mina: sure:
```dockerfile
FROM rust:1.70-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN cargo build --release
CMD ["/app/target/release/hello_rust"]
```
mina: also added a short `curl` example and a Rust SDK snippet using `async`/`await` and `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env var.
raj: thumbs up for async. can you show the snippet?
mina:
```rust
use redwood::Client;
#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
  let api_key = std::env::var("REDWOOD_API_KEY").expect("set REDWOOD_API_KEY");
  let client = Client::new(&api_key);
  let resp = client.generate("rwd-base-1", "Hello").await.unwrap();
  println!("{}", resp.output);
}
```

mina: added a one-liner about service tokens and scope example: `scopes: generate, embeddings`
